idea-plugin.name: lojou
idea-plugin.description:
AI Agent - Offline Coding Assistant

A fully offline AI coding agent powered by Ollama or llama.cpp. No internet connection required. Your code and database queries never leave your machine.

Features:

  • Chat Interface: Talk to your AI agent naturally
  • DataGrip & SQL Support: Inspect, write, optimize, and refactor SQL queries, DDL schemas, and migrations
  • Code Generation & Refactoring: Agent writes and edits code and database script files
  • Project & Schema Awareness: Agent reads project structure, SQL scripts, and surrounding queries
  • 100% Offline: Local inference with Ollama or GGUF models
  • Agentic Tools: Read, write, edit, search, and list files
  • Broad IDE Compatibility: Works seamlessly in IntelliJ IDEA, DataGrip, and IntelliJ Platform IDEs
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.0.4
  • Added full DataGrip compatibility for working with SQL and database scripts
  • Added SQL-aware prompt guidance, query optimization, and DDL/DML editing examples
  • Added context menu actions to EditorPopupMenu and ConsoleEditorPopupMenu for rapid SQL access
1.0.3
  • Fixed context prune loop covering all tool responses and large messages
  • Direct num_ctx=16384 injection to Ollama endpoint ensuring large service classes load seamlessly
1.0.2
  • Dynamic 16K context window allocation and CPU thread limits in Ollama
  • Automatic context window pruning preventing HTTP 400 exceed_context_size errors
  • Optimized 8-thread default matching modern multi-core CPUs
1.0.1
  • Smart cursor line and selected code window injection for instant targeted editing
  • Extended read_file capacity up to 25KB with start_line and end_line slice support
  • Multi-level whitespace & CRLF tolerance in edit_file tool
  • Heuristic tool resolution and loop breaker for small local models
  • Thread-safe EDT context capture preventing ReadAction errors
1.0.0
  • Native Ollama auto-detection and support
  • Agentic tools: read, write, edit, list, search files
  • Direct settings button in tool window and Tools menu
